content.comment_body: Hello, regarding the [product_name] [article_no], I am unable to get the input to work, even though the module is new. I've tried different connection methods and used a Fluke device to simulate 4-20mA; does anyone have suggestions?
Which analog input address did you select for the channel?
My question was: Which analog input address did you assign in the software? Did you use AI1, AI2, or another?
I need to use both AI1 and AI2 for two different sensors.

Let me clarify. The maximum number of analog inputs supported by [product_name] is 8, with addresses AI1 through AI8. If, in your project settings, you enable 2 analog inputs for the base module, then AI1 and AI2 are reserved for it. For the first analog expansion module, the available addresses will be AI3 for channel one and AI4 for channel two. If you do not need any base module analog inputs, set it to zero, and then AI1 and AI2 will be assigned to the first expansion module.
Could you possibly share a screenshot of the settings? Thanks.
Go to File > Properties > Offline settings > I/O settings in the configuration software.
Good morning—thank you so much! After changing the settings it's now working. I really appreciate the help. Can you explain these settings more or share a manual I could read?
Which physical measurement range and unit does your 4-20mA signal represent?
AI2 is connected to a pressure transmitter covering 0-16 bar with a 4-20mA signal. AI1 is reading water level differential pressure, also using a 4-20mA signal.
Could you clarify what is meant by 'water level DP'?
For accurate scaling, I need details on what physical range the 4-20mA signal corresponds to.
For water level, the signal covers a range from 0 to 500 mmH2O mapped to 4-20mA.
Thank you for your assistance—I plan to apply this information to my project. Have a great day.

analysis.insight_summary: The topic involved difficulty in configuring analog inputs on a [product_name] module, particularly around input channel assignments and addressing when both the base and expansion modules are in use. Explanation about analog input allocation helped resolve the setup issue, indicating that improved documentation and more straightforward configuration processes would benefit users dealing with similar hardware and software combinations.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy and intuitive process for configuring analog input channels in both hardware and software, along with readily available support resources and clear documentation for proper setup.
